later.text: WHAT IS THE EFFECT ON THIS COURT’S JURISDICTION OF THE APRIL 28, 2023 ORDER OF THE NORTH CAROLINA SUPREME COURT?

about.text: Whether a State's judicial branch may nullify the regulations governing the "Manner of holding Elections for Senators and Representatives . . . prescribed . . . by the Legislature thereof," U.S. CONST. art. I, § 4, cl. 1, and replace them with regulations of the state courts' own devising, based on vague state constitutional provisions purportedly vesting the state judiciary with power to prescribe whatever rules it deems appropriate to ensure a "fair" or "free" election.

questionsPresented.text:
21-1271 MOORE V. HARPER
DECISION BELOW: 380 NC 317
LOWER COURT CASE NUMBER: 413PA21

QUESTION PRESENTED:

 Whether a State's judicial branch may nullify the regulations governing the
"Manner of holding Elections for Senators and Representatives . . . prescribed . . . by
the Legislature thereof," U.S. CONST. art. I, § 4, cl. 1, and replace them with regulations
of the state courts' own devising, based on vague state constitutional provisions
purportedly vesting the state judiciary with power to prescribe whatever rules it deems
